notes.title: Cozy Job Simulators: First Edition
notes.content:
The Cozy Job Simulators Event is happening until September 27th, right here on Steam! 


Check out My Tiny Park alongside a TON of amazing cozy job sim games! From parks to restaurants, this event has it all so don't miss out! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/61c18ee03554272b990f982d7105d1de199f9b59.png"]



You can check out the full event HERE!

notes.title: Back to School Games Celebration
notes.content:
Summer is coming to an end, but the fun doesn't have to stop! 


From August 25th - September 1st, check out the Back to School Games Celebration right here on Steam! There's tons of amazing games where you might even learn something! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/f5626abc1f4c8a50577ffd543a435b29de61d646.png"]



Expand your mind and get playing!

notes.title: Avalon Expo
notes.content:
Avalon Expo is coming up soon!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/fd88abec534f824932a1c44a9f379b5fc7788c1d.png"]



Drop down to Newfoundland's biggest, geekiest event of the summer at the St. John's Convention Center! From July 4th - 6th, Head over to the Pixels by RSVP table chat about the game's development and grab a FREE My Tiny Park sticker (while supplies last)! 



We'll be there all weekend and we'd love to see you there!

notes.title: Market From Another Dimension
notes.content:
Exciting news! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/7911323a7eb7051d7f0d6a04ecd7557bf8077c44.png"]



We'll be at the SJFM Market from Another Dimension THIS SUNDAY! Head over to the Pixels by RSVP table to chat about the game and grab a FREE My Tiny Park Sticker (while supplies last). 



Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Indie Assemble
notes.content:
Exciting News! 

My Tiny Park is participating in the Indie Assemble Steam Event!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/1a0c7d25e629563e3721fccc82cc1576f8ad3ebd.png

Check out over 1000 games from over 600 countries in this amazing collection of games from all over the world! We're so excited to be a part of this global celebration of incredible games from over 600 Indie developers! 

Check it out from May 5th - 11th, 2025!
